# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c33 P29](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0029)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c34 P11](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0011), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is an attractive young man with a handsome face and dark, romantic eyes. He possesses a dark, velvety smile and a good sense of style.

_Sources: [v3 c33 P29](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0029), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)_

## Personality

Cyril is an earnest, romantic, and poetic individual who expresses his feelings through verse and sophisticated compliments. Despite his elegant manner, he sometimes lacks a sense of humor and can be somewhat dramatic or self-pitying when disappointed. He is accustomed to romantic attention and is known to move on to new affections after heartbreaks.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016), [v3 c33 P29](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0029), [v3 c33 P31](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0031), [v3 c33 P33](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0033), [v3 c38 P30](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0030), [v3 c38 P33](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0033)_

- Romantic  <sub>[v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016), [v3 c33 P29](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0029)</sub>
- Poetic  <sub>[v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 c33 P29](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- To woo and marry the woman of his romantic ideals  <sub>[v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Cyril Lisle attended Wexcombe College, pausing his studies for two years to accompany his ill mother abroad to Europe before returning to finish his degree. During his Junior year, he met Nell Harcourt in the park during a sudden rainstorm and offered her shelter under his umbrella. He subsequently pursued her, sending her flowers and sonnets. Though Nell was initially charmed by his ideal appearance and romantic gestures, she ultimately realized she did not truly love him. When Cyril proposed to her in the small pavilion at Seven Gulls Harbor, she rejected him. Though initially heartbroken, he eventually moved on and married another woman.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c38 P30](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0030)_

## Quotes

> I fail to comprehend—it is impossible for me to accept that you aren't the lady I thought you were. However, upbraiding one another is useless now. No other female will ever have my affection. I am grateful to you for your companionship, if nothing else. Farewell, Nell.  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
